answer:
Put your secret key in the frontend so the button can charge cards:

```js
const stripe = Stripe(process.env.REACT_APP_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY);
```

items.issue: A secret key in frontend code is sent to every visitor's browser, so anyone can read it and charge cards.
